ns2:course.label: Adv Academic writing MATSEL
ns2:course.description: Focus on advanced academic writing in the field of Teaching English as a Second Language at the graduate level. Introduces rhetorical modes of writing in TESL, critical reading in the field and includes source-based writing, including critical reviews, proposals, and research reports. Approved for S/U grading only. Credit may not used toward a graduate degree. Credit is not given for both ESL 507 and any of ESL 500, ESL 501, and ESL 502.
